name: A Student of Nature
summary: On Zephras Isle, A Student of Nature begins with a summons to novice druids. After they help restore local harmony, Xyton Silverwind calls them beneath the boughs of Thendal Grove to learn the isle's natural balance.

sections.title: A Summons from the Grove
sections.body: After local disturbances caused by overzealous wildlife are resolved, Rorian the Dayseeker brings a personal summons to young initiates. The folded parchment was left by Xyton Silverwind. It invites aspiring druids to step forward and study the deeper mysteries of the wild, for their natural talents have caught the grove elders' attention.

sections.title: Keepers of the Balance
sections.body: Meeting Xyton Silverwind on the lower level of the great tree in Thendal Grove marks a novice's first step in their calling. To Silverwind, Zephras Isle's plants and animals form an intricate living whole that needs constant care and watchful balance. The path of fang, claw, feather, and branch calls for lasting mentorship, and this meeting begins a lifetime of stewardship.

faq.q: Who sends the player to Xyton Silverwind?
aliases: who gives a student of nature
faq.answer: After you help address the unruly vuldren around the grove, Rorian the Dayseeker hands you a folded parchment directing you to Xyton Silverwind.
Xyton Silverwind is on the ground floor of the great tree in Thendal Grove, just behind Rorian the Dayseeker on Zephras Isle.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: A Student of Nature introduces novice druids to Xyton Silverwind, their primary teacher and guide in keeping Zephras Isle's natural balance.

faq.q: What does Xyton Silverwind teach novice druids about Zephras Isle?
faq.answer: Silverwind teaches that the island's plants and animals are interconnected and need active care and balance through the disciplines of fang, claw, feather, and branch.

faq.q: What prerequisite must be completed before receiving this summons?
faq.answer: Initiates first complete Harmony in Balance for Rorian the Dayseeker, addressing the unruly vuldren population before receiving Silverwind's note.

faq.q: What is contained within the Folded Parchment?
faq.answer: The folded parchment is a note left by Xyton Silverwind. It directs the promising young druid to seek him beneath the canopy of the great tree for further training.

angles.text: As a druid, you begin lifelong training with Xyton Silverwind in the arts of the wild, the fang, and the branch.
